name: blinds
title: Blinds
description: Twenty-seven thin lines. The pointer twists them up: each is a ribbon turning about its centre, opening to a full stripe under the cursor, the white opening as tapered spindles. Curtain, inverted.
docs: One self-contained file, react only: no Tailwind, no other dependency. Mount <Blinds /> inside an element with position: relative and a size; it covers that element and is decoration only: give it no link or click handler. Suggested commit: feat: add Blinds hover texture (textures.dev/s/blinds)
